description: Defines the SubjectId interface, which represents a subject's identifier in a policy model, including methods for creating instances, retrieving issuer and subject values, and obtaining JSON schema information.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectId instance given an issuer and subject as character sequences.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectId instance from a combined issuer and subject string.

methods.name: getJsonFieldDefinition
methods.description: Returns the JSON field definition associated with this SubjectId.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer part of the SubjectId.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject value part of the SubjectId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the SubjectId.
